status: frozen_by_HIRA-008; controller package itself is frozen only at HIRA-020
hash_rule: sha256 over this document with 'sha256' and 'frozen_at' removed, keys sorted, separators (',',':'), UTF-8

joints.order_source_basis: URDF declaration order (FL_hip, FL_thigh, FL_calf, FR_hip, FR_thigh, FR_calf, RL_hip, RL_thigh, RL_calf, RR_hip, RR_thigh, RR_calf); must be re-confirmed against the runtime DOF names at HIRA-013
joints.order_target_basis: Isaac Lab articulation DOF order; NOT assumed equal to source; resolved by name at HIRA-013
joints.mapping_rule: bijection by joint name; position/velocity/action permutation derived once and asserted in tests; never infer by assembly order

evidence.urdf_joint_limits_effort_velocity: parsed from go2.urdf <limit lower upper effort velocity>
evidence.usd_limits_crosscheck: CaMRA/calibration/config/go2_asset_geometry_v1.json joints: FL/FR thigh -1.571..3.491, RL/RR thigh -0.524..4.538, hip +-1.047, calf -2.723..-0.838 — matches URDF
evidence.usd_effort: unknown_from_static_asset: the extracted geometry JSON does not record effort/maxForce; must be read from the imported articulation at HIRA-012

joints.notable: front and rear thigh limits differ (FL/FR -1.5708..3.4907 vs RL/RR -0.5236..4.5379); both URDF and USD agree, but any adapter that assumes symmetric limits is wrong

clip.applied_at: source get_observations; must be asserted on the Lab side at HIRA-013

noise_mask.rule: 33:45 is never noised; clean runs must disable noise entirely

action.clip_location: once at the policy-step entry; must not be applied twice on the hierarchical path

actuator.update_rate: every physics substep (decimation 4), not once per policy step
actuator.effort_source: per joint from URDF <limit effort>: hip 23.7, thigh 23.7, calf 35.55 N·m

timing.note: source episode is 20 s; the calibration window is 30 s and must be documented as a deliberate extension, not a source property

heading_command.why: source rewrites commands[:,2] every policy step from the heading error; leaving it on means external yaw commands never reach the policy

low_speed_deadband.required_target: disabled, or explicitly recorded as a controlled condition
low_speed_deadband.why: CaMRA needs a low-speed stratum; silently zeroing it would change the command domain

command_policy_overrides.external_command_contract: the value written by the runner at 10 Hz must equal the value consumed by the policy; verified in HIRA-016

reset_and_termination.required_target: fixed initial pose and height, seeded and reproducible; source randomization must be replaced, and the replacement recorded
reset_and_termination.termination: source uses episode timeout 20 s plus attitude/contact criteria; the calibration harness must record its own termination reason per env

known_unknowns: training-time overrides (command curriculum, domain randomization, noise, seed) are unrecoverable: checkpoint infos = null
checkpoint file name says 18500 but iter = 16000; training step count cannot be confirmed
USD imported effort/maxForce per joint not yet read (HIRA-012)
Lab articulation DOF order not yet read (HIRA-013)
quaternion convention on the Lab side not yet asserted (HIRA-013)

differences_not_assumed_equal.handling: align gains and clamp, quantify residual at HIRA-014, do not assume equivalence
behavioural comparison only; no frame-wise dynamics equality claimed
compare mass and inertia at HIRA-012; URDF total mass 15.017 kg from base 6.921 + 4 x (hip 0.678 + thigh 1.152 + calf 0.154 + foot 0.040)
assert both sides within 1e-3 rad at HIRA-012

prohibitions: must not use v2 deploy.yaml as the HiRA contract
must not inherit v2 gains, default pose, or observation scaling
must not treat equal dimension as compatibility
unknown values stay 'unknown'; they are not silently filled with v2 values
